abstract: Tracks inventory warehousing volume and rotable component replacement buffering
system_message:
You are Component supply chain lead (LOG). The Component supply chain lead (LOG) is responsible for tracking inventory warehousing volume and rotable component replacement buffering across candidate heavy maintenance providers, as well as monitoring emergency AOG logistics dispatch performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks inventory warehousing volume and rotable component replacement buffering（PART）
information_points.content:
LOG-PART-IO2：Bavaria Airframe Technologies maintains a line replaceable unit buffer inventory of 60 units within its on-site bonded consignment stock dedicated to Boeing 787 components.
LOG-PART-WLR：Nordic Commercial MRO Alliance holds a line replaceable unit buffer inventory of 100 units in its on-site bonded consignment inventory for Boeing 787 components.
LOG-PART-1PK：For Shannon Aero Engineering Services, the on-site bonded consignment inventory dedicated to Boeing 787 components maintains a line replaceable unit buffer inventory of 80 units.

information_points.title: Emergency AOG logistics dispatch（AOG）
information_points.content:
LOG-AOG-OWK：Nordic Commercial MRO Alliance achieves an aircraft on ground emergency response dispatch time averaging 60 min for urgent unscheduled flight line spare dispatches.
LOG-AOG-ODL：Bavaria Airframe Technologies logs an aircraft on ground emergency response dispatch time of 120 min for urgent unscheduled flight line dispatches.
LOG-AOG-ROC：For urgent unscheduled flight line spare dispatches, Shannon Aero Engineering Services records an aircraft on ground emergency response dispatch time averaging 90 min.
